name: DeepSeek tokenizer
usage: DeepSeek local token counting through official/open tokenizer assets and hosted API usage reconciliation
risk: DeepSeek offers an official tokenizer zip and open Hugging Face tokenizer files for offline token usage calculation. Hosted aliases can move to newer models, so API usage remains the billing source of truth.

name: Qwen tokenizer
license: Apache-2.0 for code; model-specific terms for weights/API
usage: Qwen byte-level BPE counting through official Hugging Face tokenizer files
risk: Qwen models use tokenizer.json plus model-specific chat templates and control tokens. Raw text can be counted locally when a matching tokenizer is mapped; hosted aliases and tool/chat overhead remain estimates.

name: Z.AI tokenizer API

risk: Exact GLM counting should call the official tokenizer endpoint with a server-side API key.

name: Xiaomi MiMo model/tokenizer resources

name: Hugging Face Hub / ModelScope Hub
